logger.message: #['BookingSearch outbound payload coming from calling flow =' ++ write(payload, 'application/json')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload mapObject (value, key)-> { (if (key ~= "language" and isEmpty(value)) (key): p('property.language') else if (key ~= "currencyCode" and isEmpty(value)) (key): p('property.currency') else (key): value)
}

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var validLangs = Mule::p('validLang') splitBy "," --- { messageId : vars.correlationId, language: if ( isEmpty(payload.language) ) p('property.language') else if((validLangs contains upper(payload.language)) ~= true) payload.language else "en", city: payload.city default "", countryCode: payload.countryCode default "", propertyListing: payload.propertyListing default "" }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload - "language" -"currencyCode" ++ { language: vars.reqVar.language, currencyCode: if ( isEmpty(payload.currencyCode) ) p('property.currency') else payload.currencyCode, userCountry: attributes.headers['country'] }

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "Source_App_ID" : p('application.sourceApp'), "Target_App_ID" : p('application.targetApp'), "Interface_ID" :p('inteface.experience'), "Event_Category_ID" : p('category.info'), "Operation" : p('operation.bookingV2'), "Correlation_ID" : vars.reqVar.messageId, "Message_ID" : vars.reqVar.messageId, "Process" : "BookingSearchResult-ApartmentDetailsV3Request", "HotelCode" : "", "Source_ID" : "", "Target_ID" : "", "Integration_Status" : "", "Functional_Response_Comments" : "", "Functional_Response_Status" : "", "Created_On" : (now() + |PT8H|), "Reference_Metadata" : "", "Payload" : write(payload, "application/json"), "Error_Details" :"" , "Error_StackTrace" : "", "Payload_Mime_Type" : payload.^mimeType }]
set-variable.doc:name: Request Archive

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = 'everywhere' // Mirrors the Mobile experience API's request to /v3/checkpropertyavailability (which returns // all 22 SG properties). Differences from Mobile are only where MCP has no user context. --- { messageId: vars.correlationId, memberId: payload.memberId, language: payload.language, version: payload.version, platform: payload.platform, currencyCode: if (isEmpty(payload.currencyCode default "")) p('property.currency') else payload.currencyCode, promoCorpCode: payload.promoCorpCode, propertyListing: false, isModifyJourney: payload.isModifyJourney, propertyCode: [payload.propertyCode], checkinDate: payload.checkinDate, checkoutDate: payload.checkoutDate, voucherCode: payload.voucherCode, noOfRooms: 1, noOfadults: if((sizeOf(payload.apartmentList) default 0) == 1) (payload.apartmentList[0].noOfadults default "1") else "1", noOfchildren: if((sizeOf(payload.apartmentList) default 0) == 1) payload.apartmentList[0].noOfchildren else null, minPrice: payload.minPrice, maxPrice: payload.maxPrice, asrParticipating: payload.asrParticipating, perNightRate: payload.perNightRate, apartmentList: payload.apartmentList, offerBooking: payload.offerBooking, displayToChannel: payload.displayToChannel, // Mobile: the GUEST's country of residence from the member profile; absent for anonymous // users. It is NOT the search country, so it is not sent here (MCP has no profile). countryCode: payload.countryOfResidence, // Mobile: the app's "country" header (the app always sends one). MCP sends none, and an empty // userCountry makes the process API's minBaseRate crash (500), so fall back to the search country. userCountry: payload.userCountry default attributes.headers['country'] default payload.countryCode default vars.country_or_city_code, isExcludePriceStartFrom: payload.isExcludePriceStartFrom default false, // Mobile sends "mobile"; rate plans are tagged MOBILE / WEB. "mcp" matched none. channel: "mobile" }

logger.doc:name: ON THE WIRE
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'ON THE WIRE body=' ++ write(payload, 'application/json', {indent: false}) ++ ' | headers country=' ++ ((vars.reqVar.countryCode default 'NULL') as String) ++ ', messageId=' ++ ((vars.correlationId default 'NULL') as String)]
#[output text/plain --- 'BookingSearch response status=' ++ (attributes.statusCode as String) ++ ', payload=' ++ write(payload, 'application/json')]
logger.doc:name: BookingSearch response status

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "Source_App_ID" : p('application.targetApp'), "Target_App_ID" : p('application.sourceApp'), "Interface_ID" :p('inteface.experience'), "Event_Category_ID" : p('category.error'), "Operation" : p('operation.bookingV2'), "Correlation_ID" : vars.reqVar.messageId, "Message_ID" : vars.reqVar.messageId, "Process" : "BookingSearchResult-ApartmentDetailsV3ErrorResponse", "HotelCode" : "", "Source_ID" : "", "Target_ID" : "", "Integration_Status": "Failure", "Functional_Response_Comments": write(error.errorType, "application/json"), "Functional_Response_Status": "Failure", "Created_On": (now() + |PT8H|), "Reference_Metadata": "", "Payload" : if(error.errorMessage.payload.^mimeType=="application/java") write(error.errorMessage.payload, "application/java") else if(error.errorMessage.payload.^mimeType=="application/json") write(error.errorMessage.payload, "application/json") else if(error.errorMessage.payload.^mimeType=="application/xml") write(error.errorMessage.payload, "application/xml",{"writeDeclaration":false}) else error.errorMessage.payload, "Error_Details": write(error.errorType, "application/json"), "Error_StackTrace": error.description, "Payload_Mime_Type" : payload.^mimeType }]
set-variable.doc:name: Error Archive
